# `regexp`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
regexp(str, regexp)
```

Returns true if `str` matches `regexp`, or false otherwise.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `predicate_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- regexp, example 1
> SET spark.sql.parser.escapedStringLiterals=true;
spark.sql.parser.escapedStringLiterals | true
```

```sql
-- regexp, example 2
> SELECT regexp('%SystemDrive%\Users\John', '%SystemDrive%\\Users.*');
Error: INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE.PATTERN
```

```sql
-- regexp, example 3
> SET spark.sql.parser.escapedStringLiterals=false;
spark.sql.parser.escapedStringLiterals | false
```

```sql
-- regexp, example 4
> SELECT regexp('%SystemDrive%\\Users\\John', '%SystemDrive%\\\\Users.*');
true
```

```sql
-- regexp, example 5
> SELECT regexp('%SystemDrive%\\Users\\John', r'%SystemDrive%\\Users.*');
true
```
